title: Error Analysis for Solving Elliptic Interface Problems with Randomized Neural Networks
summary: This paper presents a unified error analysis of randomized neural networks (RaNNs) for elliptic interface problems. We first derive an integral representation of Barron functions using the standard $\tanh$ activation, which yields a $C^2$-approximation bound valid for any hidden-parameter distribution supported on a cube with strictly positive density.
